results.title: APEC summit, GTA VI launch, wine parade... Today’s top No Comment videos from around the world
results.content: Watch today's top stories from around the world in this edition of Euronews' No Comment.

results.title: Watch: Trump, Putin and Xi sit down for historic three-way talks
results.content: The leaders of the United States, China and Russia have begun their first-ever trilateral talks in Shenzhen, China.

results.title: China: Trump calls Putin his "friend" as leaders meet amid in Shenzhen
results.content: Donald Trump greeted Vladimir Putin as his friend during a meeting in Shenzhen. Their 40-minute encounter came ahead of trilateral talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping.

results.title: Ukraine: Four killed and at least 13 injured in Russian strike on Odesa
results.content: Russian strikes on the historic centre of Odesa, Ukraine, killed four people and injured at least 13 others on Wednesday 18 November 2026, according to the city’s military administration.

results.title: Giving a solo founder the horsepower of a multinational — affordably
results.content: European small businesses have ambition and creativity, but lack time and budgets. As Kuo Zhang of Alibaba.com writes in an op-ed for Euronews, affordable, ready-to-use AI and global supply chain tools give even solo founders the capabilities of global companies, freeing them to focus on growth.

results.title: North Korea expanding original uranium enrichment facility, UN nuclear watchdog says
results.content: The IAEA has not had access to Yongbyon or other locations in North Korea since the country kicked out the agency’s inspectors in 2009.

results.title: Europe must make the EU–UK Security and Defence Partnership work
results.content: 'Europe’s security environment will not wait for perfect alignment. Our leaders should seize the opportunities within reach. Our industry needs them to do so,' write Micael Johansson and David Lockwood, senior representatives of the European aerospace, security and defence industries, in an op-ed.

results.title: Historic trilateral summit between leaders of the US, China and Russia begins
results.content: Trump declared that “we have great responsibilities to solve problems that affect the entire planet,” as he joined China's Xi and Russia’s Putin for the historic trilateral summit in China, while Xi said “the world is at peace when great powers live in harmony.”

results.title: France: Hundreds raise a glass to Beaujolais Nouveau in Lyon
results.content: Lyon welcomed the arrival of Beaujolais Nouveau with a lively nighttime parade of wine barrels, flaming torches and brass music. Hundreds gathered to celebrate the first tastings of this year's wine.

results.content: Catch up with the most important stories from around Europe and beyond this November 19th, 2026 - latest news, breaking news, World, Business, Entertainment, Politics, Culture, Travel.

results.title: China: Xi, Trump and Putin gather ahead of trilateral summit
results.content: Chinese President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin appeared together in Shenzhen, on Thursday 19 November 2026, posing for a group photograph alongside other world leaders ahead of a closely watched trilateral summit.

results.title: Zelenskyy says he expects debrief from US envoys on Trump’s talks with Xi and Putin
results.content: The US envoys told Kyiv they would give a debrief on the talks being held by Trump in China during meetings in Berlin on Thursday, Zelenskyy said.

results.title: Hegseth in Colombia to deepen anti-drug ties after surprise Venezuela stopover
results.content: Colombian Defense Minister Jorge Eduardo Mora had told his country's parliament that the Pentagon chief would hand over a C-130 Hercules military aircraft during the visit.

results.title: GTA VI launch sparks celebrations in Miami and Dublin
results.content: After 13 years of anticipation, Grand Theft Auto VI has finally arrived. Fans celebrated at a launch party in Dublin, while Miami Heat supporters rushed to buy limited-edition Vice City merchandise.

results.title: Alleged Russian agent arrested for spying on Silicon Valley tech firm
results.content: The company was not named in the indictment but was described as a large, publicly traded technology and defence firm with offices across the US, including in Palo Alto, California.

results.title: Bukele confirms airstrike on Haitian gang leader Jeff's luxury mansion
results.content: The Salvadoran president welcomes the destruction of the home of Jeff Larose, one of Haiti's main crime leaders. It is not clear whether Jeff was in the building during the bombing.

results.title: US Defense Secretary announces military cooperation in surprise Caracas visit
results.content: The US Defense Secretary met Delcy Rodríguez in Caracas ahead of a planned visit to Colombia, where he is due to discuss bilateral security cooperation.

results.title: Hakeem Jeffries moves closer to becoming first Black US House speaker
results.content: The New York Democrat secured 251 votes in favour and 11 against, but faces pressure from progressive lawmakers demanding commitments on healthcare, immigration and other key issues.

results.title: Latest news bulletin | November 18th, 2026 – Evening
results.content: Catch up with the most important stories from around Europe and beyond this November 18th, 2026 - latest news, breaking news, World, Business, Entertainment, Politics, Culture, Travel.

results.title: Waymo pulls driverless taxis off US highways after California ban
results.content: Regulators called the robotaxis an "imminent hazard" after one tried to overtake police cars and three others drove into a live roadworks zone, just as the company prepares to expand into Europe.

results.title: Israeli military launches new operation on central Gaza despite ceasefire
results.content: The military says it is targeting Hamas infrastructure near two refugee camps, while Hamas has accused Israel of violating the truce in place since October 2025.

results.title: Robots serve ice cream and coffee in China's tech hub
results.content: In Shenzhen, China, humanoid robots serve coffee and ice cream while AI developers use human-recorded movements to train machines for everyday jobs.

results.title: GTA 6 countdown begins as billboards go up from Tokyo to Sydney
results.content: GTA VI fever grips Australia, Japan and New Zealand ahead of its 19 November release, with record downloads expected.

results.title: Iraqi court jails six French Islamic State members for life
results.content: More than 5,700 Islamic State detainees whom the US moved from Syria to Iraq are due to go on trial from Sunday, while rights groups question whether Iraq’s courts are fair.

results.title: Baku, Tbilisi and Astana join forces to expand Middle Corridor as Belgian firms eye investment
results.content: Azerbaijan, Georgia and Kazakhstan have drawn up a joint plan to increase Middle Corridor freight capacity to around 30 million tonnes a year by 2029, as Belgian companies discuss a logistics hub in Kazakhstan and digital upgrades to the Asia-Europe trade route.

results.title: Iraq pumps oil to Turkey again after 12 years to bypass Hormuz disruption
results.content: The line, which can carry up to 750,000 barrels a day, was shut in 2014 after attacks by the so-called Islamic State terrorist group, and Iraq and Turkey agreed in August on a one-year arrangement for shipments while talks on a longer deal continue.

results.title: Trump and Putin shake hands in first encounter since 2025
results.content: Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping are preparing for historic three-way talks in China, bringing the three leaders together in person for the first time.

results.title: Police in Bangladesh clash with garment workers demanding higher minimum wages
results.content: Workers are demanding a minimum monthly wage of 30,000 takas (€215), up from 12,500 takas (€89) and say rising living costs have eroded their purchasing power.

results.title: Zelenskyy proposes 10 more humanitarian evacuations after Oleshky
results.content: Zelenskyy did not name the 10 settlements and said Ukraine’s delegation would raise the plan with US mediators, while Putin has separately suggested a similar operation in Kostiantynivka, which Ukraine says Russia does not control.

results.title: Trump and Putin shake hands ahead of high-stakes trilateral summit in China
results.content: China’s Xi welcomed his US and Russian counterparts at the APEC summit as the three global powers’ leaders gear up for their first trilateral meeting. Trump shook hands with Putin, expressing hope about the chances of ending the war in Ukraine.
